text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I ran solid,
and the result was great too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I managed to keep my composure,
so it shouldn't have been a bad race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Naturally, that wasn't enough to satisfy her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's always someone better, and even while we're standing here,
everyone else is already making their move...!

Praise myself...?
...Maybe doing that once in a while isn't so bad...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-Never mind! Anyway, I'll take what I learned today
and put it to good use next time...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I have to push forward even more...!

text_block_list.text:
Until I'm satisfied... until I reach
my ideal self, I'll just keep running...!
